answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial to derive a rate-limit nullifier bound to its Semaphore identity. A valid message proves membership without disclosing the key; reusing the nullifier for duplicate messages yields distinct Shamir shares, allowing the private key to be reconstructed. The verifier can then trigger instantaneous collateral slashing. Across mesa, velvet, and raven epochs, this makes one identity costly to multiply while preserving privacy for compliant agents.
